notAFolder.purpose: Error: the chosen path isn't a folder.
notAFolder.where: Shown where adding a music folder fails because the path isn't a folder ({{path}}).

badPath.purpose: Error: the chosen location can't be used.
badPath.where: Shown where adding a music folder fails because the path is unusable ({{path}}).

alreadyAdded.purpose: Error: the folder is already a music folder.
alreadyAdded.where: Shown where adding a music folder fails because it's already added ({{path}}).

insideMusicFolder.purpose: Error: the folder is inside an existing music folder.
insideMusicFolder.where: Shown where adding a music folder fails because a parent is already a music folder ({{musicFolder}}).

containsMusicFolder.purpose: Error: the folder contains an existing music folder.
containsMusicFolder.where: Shown where adding a music folder fails because it holds an existing one ({{musicFolder}}).

notFound.purpose: Error: the music folder doesn't exist in the app.
notFound.where: Not reached from a screen yet: no command in the app's current UI looks up a single music folder; would show if one fails because the folder wasn't found.

inUse.purpose: Error: a music folder can't be removed while tracks use its files.
inUse.where: Not reached from a screen yet: no screen removes music folders; would show when removal is refused because Library tracks link to files in the folder.
inUse.approved: Can't remove: tracks use files in this folder
